body: Shopping from Change
Cut your mobile bill in half. Plus, try free for a year. No commitment.
Coverage wherever life takes you, on the nation’s most reliable 5G network. Check coverage
Access the 5G Ultra Wideband network on 5G-capable devices in 5G coverage areas.
Your device will instantly connect to Xfinity’s 20+ million secure WiFi hotspots when you’re on the go. Enjoy unlimited mobile hotspot data on Mobile Plus and Mobile Select.
And, with WiFi PowerBoost, you’ll automatically get speed boosts up to a gig on hotspots. Learn more about WiFi PowerBoost
No term contracts. Ever. You can cancel anytime.
There are no phone line access fees. Plus, if it's your first order, we'll cover the $25 activation fee for every line through 7/21.

Enjoy lifetime device protection through Xfinity Mobile Care Plus, included with our Mobile Plus plan. It covers repairs, replacements, and live tech help for your phone and any eligible tablets and watches connected to your account, whether you bought them or brought them.
Or add on Xfinity Mobile Care by device if you have our Mobile Select plan. Xfinity Mobile Care details

With Mobile Plus, you can upgrade your device whenever you're ready, even before it's paid off, and even if it's damaged. Plus, you'll get a guaranteed discount on your new device. Learn more about upgrades
You can bring all your devices to Xfinity Mobile, or shop our great deals.
If your fees for smartwatches and tablets total over $35/mo, we’ll automatically credit back the extra (excludes taxes and fees). Included with our latest plans, for up to 10 devices.
The standard monthly fee is $20 per tablet line and $10 per cellular watch line.
Our latest plans are Mobile Select and Mobile Plus. With both plans, you’ll experience incredible coverage on our reliable 5G network and 20+ million WiFi hotspots.
Both Mobile Select and Mobile Plus include unlimited talk, text, and data in the US — plus international roaming talk, text, and data in 215+ destinations.
You’ll also get automatic speed boosts up to a gig on WiFi at home or on our hotspots with WiFi PowerBoost, included with both plans.
For additional premium features, like device protection included, choose Mobile Plus.

Yes, you can bring your own compatible phone and keep your current number. Bringing your phone is the fastest way to switch — you can activate in minutes with eSIM. We’ll even handle porting your number from your old carrier for you.
You can also bring the tablets and smartwatches you already have, but we’ve always got great deals on devices if you’re ready to upgrade.
Yes. Both Mobile Select and Mobile Plus offer unlimited data, talk, and text in the US. You’ll enjoy high-speed data that keeps up with your streaming and browsing, and you’ll never run out.
Both of our latest plans also include unlimited international data, talk, and text for 215+ destinations at no extra cost.
